name: External Auditor Evidence Map
description: Structured evidence mapping and packaging for external audit engagements. Aggregates evidence from the full Quantora audit chain, maps it to auditor requests, packages deliverables, and tracks acknowledgment.

components.description: Initialize and manage external audit engagement lifecycle
Map available evidence artifacts to auditor information requests
Build structured evidence packages for auditor delivery
Record and verify auditor receipt acknowledgments
Close audit engagements and seal the final record
Frontend operator panel for engagement management
